meta.note: All human-facing values derive from this file. Do not eyedrop colours or sizes from the mockup image — read them from here.

degreeSpectrum.formula: hue = (230 + 30*i) % 360, saturation 68% both themes. Lightness: dark is a flat 58%; light is PER-HUE — each hue's own maximum lightness (capped at 48%) that still clears the locked 3.24:1 contrast floor against #F3F1ED. Blue/red/purple hues (1,5,2,6,3,7) land near the 48% cap (4.3–6.7:1); the yellow-green cluster (#4,b2,b6,b3,b7) stays close to their individual floors (~34–36%) since they have the least contrast headroom. Perfect 4th sits near 46%.
degreeSpectrum.note: Hue rotates by circle of fifths (1,5,2,6,3,7,#4,b2,b6,b3,b7,4), so colour distance encodes harmonic distance. Never used as background/gradient/flourish outside data.

octave.note: Not part of the fifths spectrum — same pitch class as tonic, doubled. Rendered as a neutral hub colour, not a hue.

semantic.currentTrialMarker: color.*.accent — ring around the node currently playing, and the primary Play button. This is the ONLY use of the accent.
semantic.correctFill: degreeSpectrum value of the correct degree in the current theme — never a new colour, never the accent
semantic.incorrectMarker: NEUTRAL ink-2 outline ring on the wrong tap — the accent must never mark a wrong answer (ART-DIRECTION §4, belief 4: no red X where a wrong note will do)
semantic.dialFill: degreeSpectrum value of the currently-playing degree for roughness/fusion; tonal pull uses ink-2, never a hue, since it has no acoustic referent

typography.numerals: Every acted-upon numeral (accuracy %, cents, beat rate, trial count, semitones) is JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

radii.note: Sharp corners throughout — instrument, not toy. 2px is the only non-zero radius, used on buttons/tiles/inputs.

easing.note: A needle settling — fast in, gentle settle. No bounce, no spring, no celebratory motion on correct.

motion.principle: needle settling; celebratory/bounce motion is prohibited (§8)

wheel.note: No home tick. The tonic is marked structurally by fill + heavier stroke + fixed 12 o'clock position alone — a separate tick mark was found redundant and prone to colliding with adjacent elements, so it was removed rather than repositioned again.

degreeNode.note: The wheel is the sole answer surface in Drill — there is no separate button grid. Node hit targets must be >=44px.

revealedAnswerRing.correct: fills solid with its own degree hue
revealedAnswerRing.incorrectTap: ink-2 outline ring, no fill, never the accent

feelingWord.seededFrom: our suggested word, shown as a pre-filled but user-editable text field with a visible edit affordance
feelingWord.note: Per-user vocabulary is personal — never impose a single word as fixed

explanationDisclosure.label: Why ▸ / Why ▾
explanationDisclosure.exception: tonal pull's claim-limiting note (learned expectation, not acoustics) stays visible by default as a one-line statement; only its longer explanation is behind the toggle

trend.belowMinimum: show session count only, label the trend as too small to read — do not display a delta (ART-DIRECTION §9: state a measurement's limits alongside the measurement)
trend.tone: factual only — report the change, no congratulatory language, no exclamation marks

modes.drill: wheel (also the answer surface) + play control + one feedback line naming the interval, never the feeling word; no dials, stats, or SRS box numbers
modes.study: free exploration; editable feeling word; three dials; waveform (time domain) + harmonic comb (frequency domain) behind why-toggles; no scoring
modes.progress: window selector + trend readout + accuracy-by-degree table + confusion matrix; reviewed after a session, never during one

targets.note: Octave must be included everywhere the other 12 degrees are: Drill's answer surface, Progress's accuracy table, and Progress's confusion matrix (13x13, not 12x12).

markUsage: Every lockup of the full 12-arc mark (headers, nav, wordmark lockups) must render at >=24px. Below that, use the plain-ring-plus-tick fallback, never a shrunk 12-arc mark.
